brief.moment: PayFlo expense system rollout, first week of March
brief.objective: Submit each receipt the same day, instead of hoarding forty of them until the last day of the quarter
brief.audience: ~400 drivers and warehouse leads, at the top of the March all-hands, then permanently in onboarding
bannedWording: Concur, or any named previous vendor
stories: The Marcy tire story: Marcy in Dispatch expensed a truck tire on a personal card and waited eleven weeks for reimbursement. It is why nobody trusts the old system.
brief.tone: Warm, funny, a little self-aware. Never corporate rock.
brief.genreReference: Motown soul with a live horn section, Tower of Power energy, handclaps on the two and four
constraints: Under 90 seconds for the all-hands slot
vagueAnswersProbed: That's a feeling, and I can't write a feeling. Say it worked — what does somebody do differently on Tuesday that they wouldn't have done on Monday?
